name: @conductor/providers
description: Model routing engine (docs/adr/0008-fase7-model-routing-and-providers.md D2/D3/D5/D7/D9): resolveModelForGate/buildResolutionContext as a pure function over an already-read snapshot (never lanca, sempre devolve um ResolutionTrace); AvailabilityCache (probe sob demanda, em memoria, nunca no caminho quente -- D7); UsageLedgerWriter/UsageLedgerReader (molde grounding-ledger.ts, priced decidido pela PROVENIENCIA do catalogo do vendor, nunca pelo valor de Model.cost -- D9/F1). Depends on @conductor/config for ModelPolicy/GateModelRole (pure data, D1) and on @earendil-works/pi-ai + @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent for the vendor catalog/ModelRuntime this engine composes over (D2 -- never a second provider-HTTP implementation).
